gui.noDocument: Open an interface to see what it holds.
gui.locked: Locked — the pointer does not catch it

guiTools.addHint: Lays an element inside what is selected
guiTools.duplicateHint: Copies the selection right beside itself
guiTools.groupHint: Files the selection into a panel
guiTools.deleteHint: Takes the selection out of the interface
guiTools.lockHint: Puts the selection out of the pointer’s reach
guiTools.fitHint: Frames the whole page in the panel
guiTools.actualHint: One page pixel for one screen pixel
guiTools.resolutionHint: The canvas this interface is composed for

typeHints.stack: Lays its children in a row or a column
typeHints.grid: Lays its children in even columns
typeHints.spacer: Pushes its neighbours apart in a stack
typeHints.button: What one acts on, with or without an icon
typeHints.progress: A bar filled to a value

resolutionHints.desktop720: Desktop, sixteen ninths, half the pixels
resolutionHints.free: Whatever size the document already holds
